episodes.synopsis: A ragtag bunch sets out across a nation at war to find and eliminate wangliang, evil spirits that latch onto negativity and turn humans into monsters.
episodes.title: The Hunters

episodes.synopsis: The Hunters get word of a wangliang on the rampage, but the telltale miasma is nowhere to be found. A standoffish Xiao Ling strikes out on her own.
episodes.title: Guizhan Attack

episodes.synopsis: A traumatic scene at a village triggers something deep within Xiao Ling, who takes on too much miasma and runs amok, endangering all those around her.
episodes.title: The Chain Tactic

episodes.synopsis: Three blood brothers sworn to save a country at war are torn apart when a shadowy fortuneteller co-opts the youngest for her own nefarious purposes.
episodes.title: Band of Brothers

episodes.synopsis: Ding Yan's distrust of Xiao Ling is growing when he reunites with his old Sixth Unit comrades--who happen to have a problematic favor to ask of him.
episodes.title: Traitor

episodes.synopsis: When Xiao Ling doesn't recover after her Guizhan duty, the team learns about the curse she bears, then takes a detour in hopes of a way to lift it.
episodes.title: Curse-Heart

episodes.synopsis: Ying Ji and Xiao Ling just can't seem to escape the wangliang that's hunting them. The entire Sixth Unit must work together to take the behemoth down.
episodes.title: Daredevil

episodes.synopsis: The team visits an insular group that claims to have a remedy for Xun Qiao's deathly ill brother, but they soon realize that something's not right.
episodes.title: Cult of the Phoenix

episodes.synopsis: The truth of the cult is revealed, along with their reasons for wanting Xiao Ling. More revelations come to light as Xun Qiao mourns her dear brother.
episodes.title: Sorrowful Song

episodes.synopsis: The Hunters enjoy some downtime after their last battle, courtesy of Lady Luozhi. Ying Ji must pay the price for keeping his teammate Xiao Ling safe.
episodes.title: Lake of Demon Tears

episodes.synopsis: A betrayal is revealed, and the Hunters must once again rescue Xiao Ling after not one, but two villains are dead set on obtaining her curse-heart.
episodes.title: The Palace of Fiends

episodes.synopsis: With the birth of "Princess Wangliang", the group will have to take extreme and desperate measures to prevent the Gate of Sorrows from opening.
episodes.title: The Wangliang Princess
